import java.util.Scanner;
import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class EducationalRound86E_V1 {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;
    static final int MAX = (int)4e5 + 10;
    static long[] fact = new long[MAX];
    static long[] invFact = new long[MAX];

    public static void precompute() {
        fact[0] = fact[1] = 1;
        invFact[0] = invFact[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < MAX; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD;
            invFact[i] = invFact[i-1] * modPow(i, MOD-2) % MOD;
        }
    }

    public static long modPow(long a, long e) {
        long res = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = res * a % MOD;
            a = a * a % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * invFact[r] % MOD * invFact[n-r] % MOD;
    }

    public static void solve(Scanner sc, PrintWriter out) {
        precompute();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        if (k == 0) {
            out.println(fact[n]);
            return;
        }
        if (n <= k) {
            out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        long ans = nCr(n, k);
        int cols = n - k;
        long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= cols; i++) {
            long term = nCr(cols, i) * modPow(cols - i, n) % MOD;
            if ((i & 1) == 1) {
                sum -= term;
                if (sum < 0) sum += MOD;
            } else {
                sum += term;
                if (sum >= MOD) sum -= MOD;
            }
        }
        out.println(2 * ans % MOD * sum % MOD);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        solve(sc, out);
        out.close();
        sc.close();
    }
}
